statement: Fujita’s freeness conjecture. Proves Fujita's freeness conjecture at its sharp bound in every dimension: for a smooth projective complex variety X of dimension n and an ample line bundle L, the adjoint $`K_X+mL`$ is globally generated for every integer $`m\ge n+1`$.
